chapter: Swing and what makes a band play
title: Dancers and what bands teach them
summary: They discuss whether Bird's music suited dancers and agree a band educates its dancers, who dance to what they grasp.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: Well, not until you were hip to it, Jay, maybe.
No, I hadn't given that a thought. You do have to take the dancers under consideration. That is true, that is true, because actually what a band does is educate the dancers.
So the dancers go by the best education, according to what they hear. You're right.

Well, when you were saying about him playing so many notes, while the dancers can't dance to the notes, now, you know, a black audience is supposed to dance to the rhythm and they always say that white dancers dance to the melody more. Well, now, when Bird comes along with that very involved stuff, I don't know, you know. It's the same with Dizzy's thing.
Well, listen, I mean, it really goes back like to the time of Prez. When people began to grasp what was happening, then they danced in a different way.
That's true. They dance a different way, according to what they grasp. If they heard this different, then they danced different to it. That is true.
